name: temper
description: The rust-craft Rust engineering standard (ownership, APIs, errors, architecture, TDD, performance, async, structured output, no escape hatches) plus the hooks, subagents and gates that make agents follow it: skill-load gate, pre-write escape-hatch scanner, protected config, completion gate with fingerprint-bound independent review, a lint-baseline ratchet for existing codebases, and a compliance report.
